{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Exploration Academy''' was a division of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], based in the [[Vanik system/Legends|Vanik system]]. Considered less prestigious than the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Academy]] on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]] or the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]], it trained [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] for the [[Imperial Exploration Corps/Legends|Imperial Exploration Corps]] for the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
